GOT QUESTIONS? WE HAVE ANSWERS.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything you need to know about setting up, securing, and scaling your community with Veyra.

How does VEYRA's Anti-Nuke system prevent rogue admins and token leaks?

VEYRA monitors Discord audit logs in sub-15ms real-time. If an admin or compromised account deletes channels, strips roles, or spam-kicks members beyond your configured safety thresholds, VEYRA immediately strips their permissions, auto-restores destroyed channels and roles, and quarantines their account.

Can I whitelist co-owners, trusted bots, and staff members?

Yes. The Whitelist management suite allows you to exempt trusted staff members, specific roles, or designated channels from anti-raid, mass-ban, and channel deletion locks with granular tier-based permissions.

How does the Verification Gate stop bot raids and alt accounts?

VEYRA locks your server channels behind an interactive verification portal. New members must solve an interactive button or web-captcha gate before accessing the community. You can also enforce a minimum account age requirement to filter out freshly generated raid alts.

Can I create and manage Giveaways directly from the Web Dashboard?

Absolutely! The Giveaway Manager tab features a real-time live Discord embed preview simulator. You can customize prizes, duration timers, winner counts, role requirements, bonus entry multipliers, and draw or reroll winners with a single click.

How does the Ticket System work and can staff export HTML transcripts?

VEYRA provides an enterprise-grade ticketing suite with one-click button or dropdown panels. Staff can claim, transfer, add members, and close tickets. Upon closure, VEYRA automatically generates and archives complete interactive HTML transcripts with attachments and timestamps.

What are Sticky Roles and how do they restore member roles on rejoin?

Sticky Roles cache every role a user holds in the database. If a member leaves or gets temporarily kicked, VEYRA automatically restores all their previous roles when they rejoin, while keeping muted or penalty roles isolated via blacklist rules.

Does VEYRA support temporary VoiceMaster channels and 24/7 Voice?

Yes. With VoiceMaster, members who join a "Join to Create" voice room automatically get an isolated, private voice channel where they can customize the room name, lock the channel, adjust bitrates, or set user limits. VEYRA also supports 24/7 locked voice channel connections.

Can I customize the bot's prefix, welcome cards, and embed colors per server?

Every server has independent custom configuration. You can change command prefixes, design rich welcome and goodbye embeds with dynamic tags (like {user}, {server}, {count}), upload custom banner graphics, and customize embed accent colors to match your server identity.

Is VEYRA free to use, and what do Pro and Premium tiers unlock?

VEYRA is 100% free with core moderation, anti-nuke protection, autoroles, and utility commands included. Pro and Premium tiers unlock unlimited ticket panels, advanced captcha verification, high-frequency audit logs, custom bot branding, and priority cloud cluster routing.

What is VEYRA's uptime guarantee and operational response speed?

VEYRA runs on distributed multi-region cloud infrastructure with automated health monitors and failover worker nodes, ensuring a 99.99% operational uptime SLA and ultra-fast sub-15ms response latency for all commands and security audits.

Enable Captcha Challenge

Verification channel will only be visible for the unverified users, it contains the information about what should they do to get access for other channels, it's optional if you use Web Captcha, and it's required if you use One-Click or Captcha Code.

Verified role will be given to the users after completing the verification captcha.

Help & Support
Automated Role Progression Flow

When Verification Gate is active, newly joined members are automatically assigned the Unverified Role upon joining the server. Once they complete verification via the button panel, the unverified restriction is stripped and the designated Verified Role is granted immediately in real time.

Verification settings

Require new members to verify before their join is processed.

Enabled
New members must complete verification before their join is processed.
Verification level
High-performance instant one-click Discord interaction button.
BUILT-IN
Unverified role
The quarantine role automatically assigned to members upon joining.
Verification role
The role granted to members once they verify.
Timeout action
The action taken on a member when their verification times out.
Verification timeout
How long members have to verify, in seconds.

Announcements can be disruptive to conversations, pick a destination that fits your server.

                                
                            


                            
                            

                                
                                
One common complaint regarding bots with levels is that they spam you. To combat this, the bot allows you to only announce level ups if they are evenly divisible by a number. For instance, setting this number to 5 would announce levels 5, 10, 15 etc.

                                
                                
Your first 5 announced levels are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

                            


                            
                            

                                
                                
Because the xp required for each levels increases dramatically, it might be appealing to only announce levels after a certain point. This setting is inclusive.

                                                         Panel Editing Guide
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
Welcome to the Panel Editor! This guide will help you create and customize your support panel. Click on any element in the preview to start editing.

                                                        
                                                        Understanding Your Panel
                                                        Your panel is made up of three types of components:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Embeds - The message cards that display your panel content (title, description, images, colors)
    • 
                                                            
  • Buttons - Clickable buttons that open tickets/applications or link to external URLs
    • 
                                                            
  • Select Menus - Dropdown menus with multiple options for users to choose from
    • 
                                                        


                                                        Editing Embeds
                                                        Click on any embed in the preview to edit it. You can customize:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Title & Description - The main text content of your embed
    • 
                                                            
  • Color - The colored accent bar on the left side of the embed
    • 
                                                            
  • Author - Optional header with name and small icon above the title
    • 
                                                            
  • Footer - Optional text and icon at the bottom of the embed
    • 
                                                            
  • Image - A large image displayed within the embed
    • 
                                                            
  • Thumbnail - A small image in the top-right corner
    • 
                                                            
  • URL - Makes the title clickable as a link
    • 
                                                        

                                                        
You can have up to 10 embeds. Use the arrows or drag handles to reorder them.


                                                        Working with Buttons
                                                        Buttons are the primary way users interact with your panel. Click any button to edit:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Label - The text shown on the button (click directly to edit inline)
    • 
                                                            
  • Emoji - An optional icon displayed before the label
    • 
                                                            
  • Style - The button color (Primary, Secondary, Success, Danger)
    • 
                                                            
  • Link Buttons - These open a URL instead of creating a ticket
    • 
                                                        

                                                        
Each row can hold up to 5 buttons. You can have up to 5 rows of buttons and select menus combined.


                                                        Working with Select Menus
                                                        Select menus let users choose from a dropdown list. Click the menu or any option to edit:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Placeholder - The text shown before a selection is made
    • 
                                                            
  • Options - Each option has a label, optional description, and optional emoji
    • 
                                                        

                                                        
Each select menu can have up to 25 options. Drag options to reorder them.


                                                        Ticket Questions
                                                        Ticket Questions are prompts that appear when a user clicks a button or selects an option. They collect information before the ticket is created.
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Short Text - Single-line text input for brief answers
    • 
                                                            
  • Long Text - Multi-line text area for detailed responses
    • 
                                                            
  • Mark questions as required or optional
    • 
                                                            
  • Add placeholder text to guide users
    • 
                                                        

                                                        
Questions are configured per button or option. Select a button/option to manage its questions.


                                                        Button & Option Configuration
                                                        Each button and select menu option has additional settings. For ticket panels:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Categories - Which channel categories can receive tickets
    • 
                                                            
  • Ticket Roles - Staff roles that can view and manage the ticket
    • 
                                                            
  • Ticket Pings - Roles to ping when a ticket is created
    • 
                                                            
  • Ticket Content - Custom message sent when ticket is created
    • 
                                                            
  • Required Roles - Roles users must have to use this option
    • 
                                                        

                                                        For application panels:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Application Type - Label for the type of application
    • 
                                                            
  • Reviewer Roles - Who can review and vote on applications
    • 
                                                            
  • Granted Roles - Roles given when an application is approved
    • 
                                                            
  • Roles to Remove - Roles removed when an application is approved
    • 
                                                            
  • Requirements - Minimum account age or server membership
    • 
                                                            
  • Cooldowns - How long users must wait to reapply
    • 
                                                        


                                                        Drag and Drop
                                                        Reorder elements by dragging them:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Rows - Drag the grip handle next to "Embed", "Buttons", or "Select Menu" to reorder entire rows
    • 
                                                            
  • Buttons - Drag buttons within a row to change their order
    • 
                                                            
  • Options - Drag select menu options to reorder them
    • 
                                                            
  • Embeds - Use the up/down arrows in the footer, or drag the grip handle
    • 
                                                        


                                                        Duplicating Components
                                                        Use the "Duplicate" button to copy an embed, button row, or select menu. This copies all settings, making it easy to create similar options quickly.
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Duplicate is disabled when you've reached the maximum allowed
    • 
                                                            
  • Maximum 10 embeds
    • 
                                                            
  • Maximum 5 component rows (buttons + select menus combined)
    • 
                                                        


                                                        Adding Components
                                                        Use the buttons at the bottom of the preview to add new elements:
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Add Embed - Creates a new embed card
    • 
                                                            
  • Add Button Row - Creates a new row of buttons
    • 
                                                            
  • Add Select Menu - Creates a new dropdown menu
    • 
                                                        

                                                        
Within button rows and select menus, use the ghost "+ Add" buttons to add more buttons or options.


                                                        Saving Your Changes
                                                        When you're done editing, click the Save button at the bottom of the screen to publish your changes. Your panel will be updated in Discord immediately.
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Red highlights indicate validation errors that must be fixed before saving
    • 
                                                            
  • You'll be warned if you try to leave with unsaved changes
    • 
                                                            
  • Use the Cancel button to discard all changes and start over
    • 
                                                        


                                                        Quick Tips
                                                        
    
                                                            
  • Click directly on button labels in the preview to edit them inline
    • 
                                                            
  • Use link buttons for external resources like documentation or Discord invites
    • 
                                                            
  • Keep your panel organized with clear button labels and descriptions
    • 
                                                            
  • Test your panel by creating a test ticket to ensure everything works as expected
    •

What the person who opens a ticket can do inside their ticket channel. Turn a permission off to block it for the ticket opener — for example, disable Attach Files and Embed Links to stop users from sending images or file uploads to your staff. Only the opener is restricted; staff and everyone else in the ticket keep their normal permissions.

                                                             
                                                             
                                                             
Using the panel's default (nothing configured at the panel, so this option is left blank).


                                                             

                                                                 
                                                                 

                                                                     
                                                                     These permissions are required for tickets to work and are always granted to the ticket opener.
                                                                 


                                                                 
                                                                 

                                                                     

                                                                         View Channel
                                                                         

                                                                             ACTIVE

                                                                             ACTIVE

                                                                             ACTIVE
                                                                             
                                                                         

                                                                     

                                                                     
                                                                     

                                                                         Use Application Commands
                                                                         

                                                                             ACTIVE
                                                                             
                                                                         

                                                                     

                                                                 

                                                             

                                                             
These apply only to the person who opened the ticket — not to staff or anyone else in the channel. Permissions left on aren't changed (the opener keeps their normal server permissions); permissions turned off are blocked for the opener inside the ticket. Only applies to tickets created as text channels — thread tickets follow the server's thread permissions. Note that turning off Embed Links removes link previews, but users can still post URLs as plain text.

Settings

                                            
Configure your server's settings. All changes are automatically saved.

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        
                                        
                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        
Server Settings & Logging

                                        
Core bot configuration and log channels for ticket activity.


                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                
Opened Tickets Log Channel

                                                
The channel where opened ticket logs will be sent.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Closed Tickets Log Channel

                                                
The channel where closed ticket logs, including transcripts, will be sent.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Server Language

                                                
Set the language the bot will use for all messages in this server.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Support Roles

                                                
Roles that can access and manage all tickets.

                                                

                                                    STAFF ×
                                                    
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Main Ticket Categories

                                                
Categories where all tickets will be placed.

                                                

                                                     BUY×
                                                    
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Max Active Tickets

                                                
The maximum number of tickets that can be open at the same time.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Max Active Tickets Per User

                                                
The maximum number of tickets a single user can have open at once.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Main Embed Color

                                                
The primary color of all bot messages in this server.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        
Ticket Claiming

                                        
Configure how staff members can claim and manage tickets.


                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                
Ticket Claiming Mode

                                                
Choose how ticket claiming functions. This setting will change how other staff members can interact with tickets that are claimed by another staff member.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Ping Ticket Author on Claim

                                                
Ping the ticket author when their ticket has been claimed.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Active
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Roles to Add on Claim

                                                
Roles that will be added to the ticket channel when a staff member claims it. Useful for granting specific team members access to claimed tickets.

                                                
                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        
Ticket Style and Claiming Settings

                                        
Control how tickets are created and claimed by staff.


                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                
Manual Ticket Style

                                                
Choose whether manually created tickets (using /createticket or via context menu) will be a ticket channel or thread.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Archive Thread Tickets

                                                
Choose whether thread tickets will be archived or deleted when they are closed.

                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Continuous Ticket Numbering

                                                
Automatically keep ticket numbers counting upward, instead of resetting based on open tickets.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Active
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Global Ticket Numbering

                                                
Use a single ticket counter across all ticket types instead of counting per ticket name format.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Inactive
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Ping Support Roles

                                                
Ping all configured support roles in tickets when they are opened.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Inactive
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Ticket Creates Private Staff Thread

                                                
Create a private staff thread for ticket admins for every ticket. All main roles and roles configured on the ticket will be able to access it.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Inactive
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Code-Wrap Question Responses

                                                
Wrap text answers to ticket questions in an inline code block so they're tap-to-copy on mobile. When off, answers are shown as plain text.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Inactive
                                                

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        
Ticket Close & Transcript Settings

                                        
Control how tickets close and what transcripts record.


                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                
Close Requires Support Role

                                                
If enabled, only users with a configured support role can close tickets.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Active
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Close Requires Reason

                                                
Require a reason to be provided to close a ticket.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Inactive
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Hide Closing User

                                                
Do not notify the ticket creator of who closed the ticket.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Inactive
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
DM User Close Message

                                                
Send a DM notice with transcript link to the ticket creator when their ticket is closed.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Active
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Log Staff Message Counts

                                                
Log the number of messages sent by staff members in the closed log message.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Active
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Role-Specific Transcript Viewing

                                                
Only allow staff with the Support Roles and roles configured per-ticket to view that option's transcripts.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    Active
                                                

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Default Ticket Close Reason

                                                
The default reason used when closing a ticket if no reason is provided. Leave blank to use VEYRA TICKET's default reason.

                                                
                                            

                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        

                                            
Permissions

                                            
Configure access overrides and staff role privileges.

                                        

                                    


                                    

                                        
 Temporary Dashboard Access

                                        
Generate a short-lived link letting trusted support helpers edit settings without logging into Discord.

                                        
                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        

                                            
Audit Logs

                                            
Trace internal changes made to ticket panel configurations.
